diffs.diff: header pin 1: part says VCC, datasheet reading says SIG
diffs.evidence: SparkFun TEMT6000 breakout v12 EAGLE schematic: net "VCC" contains <pinref part="JP4" gate="G$1" pin="1"/> together with U1 pin C1 (collector) and the VCC supply symbol; net "S" contains JP4 pin 3 with U1 E1 (emitter) and R1. So header pin 1 = VCC. The second reading listed the pins in silkscreen order (SIG, GND, VCC printed top to bottom), not header pin-number order; the Fritzing breakout part also defines connectors VCC, GND, S in that order.

diffs.diff: header pin 3: part says SIG, datasheet reading says VCC
diffs.evidence: SparkFun TEMT6000 breakout v12 EAGLE schematic: net "S" (signal) = U1 pin E1 (emitter) + R1 pin 2 + <pinref part="JP4" gate="G$1" pin="3"/>; JP4 pin 1 is on net VCC and pin 2 on GND. So header pin 3 = SIG. The reversed order in the second reading is the silkscreen top-to-bottom order, not pin numbering.
